top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Sea Otter Europe Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
Sea Otter Europe Gravel's Catalan farm and forest gravel, UCI Gravel World Series forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 68 miles.
When someone attacks on punchy Catalan farm and forest gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Sea Otter Europe Gravel's punchy Catalan farm and forest gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
68 miles on punchy Catalan farm and forest gravel burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
At Sea Otter Europe Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Sea Otter Europe Gravel, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Sea Otter Europe Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on punchy Catalan farm and forest gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Varied gradients on punchy Catalan farm and forest gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,084ft of climbing on punchy Catalan farm and forest gravel does to your power file on race day.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Sea Otter Europe Gravel’s 68 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Sea Otter Europe Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on punchy catalan farm and forest gravel to build confidence. Expect: catalan farm and forest gravel, uci gravel world series, girona countryside.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Gravel Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 68 miles of punchy catalan farm and forest gravel in Juià / Girona, Catalonia, Spain.
